Q5738.reason: The UCC governs a mixed contract only when goods are the predominant purpose, so Connie's UCC claim depends on meeting that requirement; C is logically equivalent, which makes this close.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the moment of entry, and he entered only to enjoy the party and formed the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: Chronic drug exposure floods the synapse with dopamine, so post-synaptic receptors downregulate, producing tolerance, craving and agitation.
